title: Workspace.Status request params
description: Per protocol-v0.md §7.4. Poll the indexing state of one mounted root (`root`, else the daemon's default root). Cheap; safe to call between every other request. The response's `mounted_roots` lists every root the daemon serves.

root.description: Mounted root to report: its `workspace_id` or its workspace path. Absent = the daemon's default root.
